sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.3
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Dated September 2, 2026; announces availability in Muse Code and Meta Model API. Describes training on longer-horizon coding tasks and diverse agentic harnesses, improved instruction following and safety, and greater coding efficiency relative to 1.2. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or new model modality is described. The current page documents max reasoning; its open-weights statement was a roadmap statement.

sources.title: Models - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Lists muse-spark-1.3 as a Standard-mode hosted model. All three numbered Spark versions accept text, images, video, audio, and PDF, output text, and have a 1,048,576-token context. Spark Open is listed separately as an open-weight model.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Evaluation Report
sources.evidence: Reopened the 140-page October 23 report and searched its complete text on October 27. It distinguishes the API checkpoint from Muse Model and system evaluations, but supplies no parameter count or structural modification such as pruning, distillation, expert expansion or added modality. Architecture mentions in model self-interviews are not technical specifications. This report does not contradict the separately documented shared-base lineage.

sources.title: Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Meta's Open checkpoint card gives nominal 816B total, 42B active and mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture, with multimodal perception. The card itself does not equate Open with the hosted 1.3 checkpoint; Meta's PyTorch launch article separately supplies the exact named shared-base relationship used for the inference.

sources.title: Muse Wonder Model Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card for the October 12 Wonder release was checked for retrospective Spark disclosures. It does not report Spark 1.3 parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Meta Model API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: October 9 terms govern hosted Meta models; Meta retains rights in the services and grants conditional access. Separate open-weight licenses do not govern API usage. Supports the descriptive proprietary license classification.

sources.title: Meta Model API Model Designation and Geographic Use Policy
sources.evidence: Names Muse Spark 1.3 among Standard Models and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor separately among Contributor Models, connecting the exact variant to the API terms.

sources.title: Reasoning - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Describes Muse Spark's internal reasoning tokens and effort controls, with API examples using the exact muse-spark-1.3 identifier.

sources.title: Tool calling - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Documents native developer-defined function tools, tool selection, and parallel calls; request examples specify muse-spark-1.3. Tool execution remains the application's responsibility.

sources.title: Video and audio understanding - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Video request examples use muse-spark-1.3. The audio section explicitly warns that 1.3 audio understanding is not fully supported and responses containing audio may be degraded; examples use 1.2 instead.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Evaluation Methodology
sources.evidence: Reopened and read the complete four-page document October 27. It covers agentic, coding, instruction-following and long-context tests for 1.3 via Meta Model API. It gives no parameter count or production architecture and describes no count-changing structural modification.

sources.title: Models.dev Muse Spark 1.3 record
sources.evidence: Followed the baseline catalog link as a discovery lead; technical conclusions use Meta's own documentation instead.

sources.title: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model
sources.evidence: October 15 first-party article, freshly reopened October 27: Open has 816B total and 42B active parameters, builds on the linked August Spark 1.2 release with additional safety post-training, and explicitly shares the same base model as Muse Spark 1.3. This exact named relationship supports a nominal shared-base size inference, rather than family resemblance.

sources.title: Build with Muse Spark Open
sources.evidence: October 15 developer article, reopened October 27, calls Open an 816B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model activating roughly 42 billion parameters per token. Establishes the published active-count convention separately from total size; it does not provide an exact hosted 1.3 tensor census.

sources.title: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL
sources.evidence: October 21 article updated October 22, reopened October 27. Under the Muse Spark Open heading, Meta identifies the release as its MuseSpark 1.2 OSS release and reports expert-parallel training. Corroborates the August-model identity in the Open safety-post-training lineage; it is not an independent 1.3 count disclosure.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The official model page says Open derives from the Muse Spark model released in August, with additional safety post-training for standalone use. Describes native multimodal perception, rather than a newly added modality or a compressed architecture.

sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark Open, The Most Capable US Open-Weight Model to Date
sources.evidence: October 15 research launch, reopened October 27, independently publishes 816B total and 42B active for the natively multimodal Open model and describes additional safety post-training. No structural size change is stated.

name.note: Exact official release name and API version.

developer.note: Meta announces and supplies this model.

family.note: The report identifies Muse Spark as the family; retained the catalog's broader normalized muse family key.

release_date.note: Explicit launch date and same-day availability; distinct from subsequent availability of the max effort setting.

open_weights.note: The exact numbered 1.3 model is hosted. The later downloadable Spark Open checkpoint is separately named and must not change 1.3's weight status.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the exact hosted Standard model under Meta Model API terms; no open-weight license is transferred from Spark Open.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 816B inferred from Meta's explicit statement that Spark Open and Spark 1.3 share the same base model. Open's 816B is published directly; its additional safety post-training and 1.3's agentic/coding training have no documented count-changing structural modification in the freshly reviewed sources. This is a documented-lineage inference, not an exact tensor count of the hosted 1.3 deployment.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal roughly 42B active per token inferred through Meta's exact shared-base statement for Spark Open and Spark 1.3. Meta explicitly publishes Open's active count and per-token convention, so this is separate evidence from total size. No count-changing structural modification is documented; exact 1.3 deployment and modality-specific active counts remain unspecified.

architecture.note: Mixture-of-experts inferred from Meta's explicit shared-base relationship with Spark Open, whose card and developer article directly specify sparse MoE architecture. No architecture-changing modification is described for 1.3.

context_window.note: Exact token count stated for all numbered Spark API versions, including 1.3.

modalities.note: Retained documented input/output types. Audio is accepted but explicitly not fully supported in 1.3, so the patch adds that limitation. PDF is a supported document input type.

reasoning.note: Native internal reasoning with controllable effort is documented for the exact API identifier.

tool_call.note: Native function-tool requests are demonstrated for muse-spark-1.3.

description.value: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta's hosted multimodal reasoning model for agentic and coding workflows. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code, it supports tool calling and a 1,048,576-token context window. Meta reports improved instruction following and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.
description.note: Replaces the unsupported specific claim of improved multi-agent collaboration with directly documented behavior and attributes comparative claims to Meta.

patch.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta's hosted multimodal reasoning model for agentic and coding workflows. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code, it supports tool calling and a 1,048,576-token context window. Meta reports improved instruction following and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.
patch.notes: Nominal 816B total, roughly 42B active per token and MoE architecture are inferred from Meta's explicit statement that Spark 1.3 and Spark Open share the same base model; no count-changing structural modification is documented. These are not exact hosted-deployment or modality-specific counts. Audio input is documented but understanding is not fully supported and response quality may be degraded.

sources.label: Meta PyTorch Spark Open and Spark 1.3 shared-base statement

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit establishes nominal 816B total and roughly 42B active per token through Meta's explicit statement that Spark Open and Spark 1.3 share the same base model. Reopened the Open card, Meta research/developer launches, PyTorch lineage and TorchTitan posts, 1.3 launch, models documentation and both complete 1.3 reports; targeted searches found no pruning, distillation, expert expansion or new modality that defeats the inference. Corrected architecture to MoE on the same documented lineage. Exact hosted-deployment and modality-specific counts remain unspecified. Preserved the other eleven field assessments, including the audio-support limitation.
